title: Email notices
purpose: Turn your own ticket notices on or off. A notice tells you that a ticket was assigned to you or that a client replied on a ticket assigned to you.
summary: Choose whether you receive short emails when a ticket is assigned to you or a client replies on one of your tickets.

tasks.title: Stop ticket notices
steps: Select [[Save]]. The page confirms your preference was saved.

tasks.title: Start them again
steps: Tick [[Email me ticket notices]] and select [[Save]].

good_to_know: Notices are on until you turn them off.
A notice names only the ticket number, what happened and the laboratory. Sign in to read the ticket.
When outgoing email is off, the page tells you. You can still save your preference for when delivery is enabled.
This page is for laboratory staff. Client portal accounts always receive their notices and cannot open it.

items.label: Email me ticket notices
items.description: Ticked: you are emailed when someone else assigns a ticket to you, and when a client replies on a ticket assigned to you, provided you can read that ticket. Cleared: you receive neither. Assigning a ticket to yourself never sends a notice.

items.label: Save
items.description: Saves the setting for your own account. The Email is off notice appears when outgoing email is disabled, even if you turn ticket notices on.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Notices are sent after the change that causes them is saved; a failed send is logged and does not undo the change. The notice carries a link to the sign-in page, which then opens the ticket. It never contains the subject, messages, organization, site, contact, category or any identifier.
